-- pico mini gp : top-down 3 lap circuit race
r=4
maxf=2
acc=0.1
brk=0.16
rev=0.7
drag=0.985
grip=0.82
turn=0.13
isles={{x0=30,y0=42,x1=97,y1=93},{x0=55,y0=112,x1=72,y1=123}}
function reset_round()
 car={x=20,y=112,a=0,vx=0,vy=0}
 marks={}
 prev={}
 lap=0
 cp=0
 race_t=0
 count=89
 last_n=3
 crash_cd=0
 flash=0
 bt=0
 banner=""
end
function _init()
 best=0
 state="title"
 reset_round()
 music(6,200,3)
end
function edge(b)
 local n=btn(b)
 local e=n and not prev[b]
 prev[b]=n
 return e
end
function tstr(f)
 local cs=flr(f*100/30)
 return flr(cs/100).."."..sub("0"..(cs%100),-2)
end
function hit_wall(nx,ny)
 local vn=car.vx*nx+car.vy*ny
 if vn<0 then
  car.vx=(car.vx-nx*vn*1.3)*0.9
  car.vy=(car.vy-ny*vn*1.3)*0.9
  if vn<-0.35 and crash_cd<=0 then
   crash_cd=12
   flash=6
   sfx(2,3)
  end
 end
end
function resolve()
 for w in all(isles) do
  local qx=mid(w.x0,car.x,w.x1)
  local qy=mid(w.y0,car.y,w.y1)
  local dx=car.x-qx
  local dy=car.y-qy
  local d=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
  if d<r then
   local nx=0
   local ny=0
   if d>0.001 then
    nx=dx/d
    ny=dy/d
   else
    local lf=car.x-w.x0
    local rt=w.x1-car.x
    local tp=car.y-w.y0
    local bm=w.y1-car.y
    local m=min(lf,min(rt,min(tp,bm)))
    if m==lf then nx=-1
    elseif m==rt then nx=1
    elseif m==tp then ny=-1
    else ny=1 end
   end
   car.x=car.x+nx*(r-d)
   car.y=car.y+ny*(r-d)
   hit_wall(nx,ny)
  end
 end
 if car.x<8 then
  car.x=8
  hit_wall(1,0)
 elseif car.x>119 then
  car.x=119
  hit_wall(-1,0)
 end
 if car.y<20 then
  car.y=20
  hit_wall(0,1)
 elseif car.y>119 then
  car.y=119
  hit_wall(0,-1)
 end
end
function finish_lap()
 lap=lap+1
 cp=0
 if lap>=3 then
  state="win"
  bt=0
  if best==0 or race_t<best then best=race_t end
  music(-1,200)
  sfx(3,3)
 else
  bt=45
  banner="LAP "..lap
  sfx(0,3)
 end
end
function check_gates(px,py)
 local x=car.x
 local y=car.y
 if cp==0 then
  if py>50 and y<=50 and x>=96 then
   cp=1
   sfx(5,3)
  end
 elseif cp==1 then
  if px>64 and x<=64 and y<=45 then
   cp=2
   sfx(5,3)
  end
 elseif cp==2 then
  if py<70 and y>=70 and x<=33 then
   cp=3
   sfx(5,3)
  end
 elseif cp==3 then
  if px<40 and x>=40 and y>=90 then finish_lap() end
 end
end
function update_race(inp)
 local fx=cos(car.a)
 local fy=sin(car.a)
 local fwd=car.vx*fx+car.vy*fy
 local spd=abs(fwd)
 local st=0
 if inp then st=(btn(1) and 1 or 0)-(btn(0) and 1 or 0) end
 if st!=0 then
  local rt=turn*max(0.3,min(1,spd/1.1))
  if fwd<0 then rt=-rt end
  car.a=(car.a+st*rt)%1
 end
 fx=cos(car.a)
 fy=sin(car.a)
 fwd=car.vx*fx+car.vy*fy
 local lat=car.vy*fx-car.vx*fy
 if inp then
  if btn(4) then fwd=min(maxf,fwd+acc) end
  if btn(5) then
   if fwd>0.05 then
    fwd=max(0,fwd-brk)
   else
    fwd=max(-rev,fwd-acc*0.6)
   end
  end
 end
 if not (inp and btn(4)) then fwd=fwd*drag end
 lat=lat*grip
 car.vx=fx*fwd-fy*lat
 car.vy=fy*fwd+fx*lat
 local px=car.x
 local py=car.y
 car.x=car.x+car.vx
 car.y=car.y+car.vy
 resolve()
 if abs(lat)>0.8 and abs(fwd)>1.1 then
  add(marks,{x=car.x+fy*3,y=car.y-fx*3})
  add(marks,{x=car.x-fy*3,y=car.y+fx*3})
  while #marks>48 do deli(marks,1) end
 end
 check_gates(px,py)
end
function _update()
 crash_cd=max(0,crash_cd-1)
 flash=max(0,flash-1)
 bt=max(0,bt-1)
 if state=="title" then
  if edge(4) then
   reset_round()
   state="count"
   sfx(-1,3)
   music(0,200,7)
  end
 elseif state=="count" then
  update_race(false)
  count=count-1
  local n=flr(count/30)+1
  if n!=last_n then
   last_n=n
   sfx(5,3)
  end
  if count<=0 then
   state="race"
   race_t=0
   bt=30
   banner="GO!"
   sfx(1,3)
  end
 elseif state=="race" then
  race_t=race_t+1
  update_race(true)
 elseif state=="win" then
  if edge(4) then
   reset_round()
   state="count"
   sfx(-1,3)
   music(0,200,7)
  elseif edge(5) then
   state="title"
   music(6,200,3)
  end
 end
 for i=0,5 do prev[i]=btn(i) end
end
function draw_world()
 rectfill(4,16,123,123,5)
 rect(2,14,125,125,8)
 rect(3,15,124,124,7)
 rectfill(30,42,97,93,8)
 rectfill(32,44,95,91,3)
 rectfill(55,112,72,123,8)
 rectfill(57,114,70,121,3)
 for i=0,7 do
  local c=0
  if i%2==0 then c=7 end
  rectfill(38,92+i*4,41,95+i*4,c)
  rectfill(42,92+i*4,45,95+i*4,7-c)
 end
end
function draw_marks()
 for m in all(marks) do
  rectfill(m.x-1,m.y-1,m.x,m.y,0)
 end
end
function draw_gates()
 local c1=6
 if cp>=1 then c1=1
 elseif cp==0 then c1=10 end
 line(99,50,119,50,c1)
 local c2=6
 if cp>=2 then c2=1
 elseif cp==1 then c2=10 end
 line(64,18,64,40,c2)
 local c3=6
 if cp>=3 then c3=1
 elseif cp==2 then c3=10 end
 line(8,70,26,70,c3)
end
function draw_car()
 local fx=cos(car.a)
 local fy=sin(car.a)
 local qx=-fy
 local qy=fx
 for i=-3,3 do
  local ln=4.6-abs(i)*0.35
  local c=8
  if abs(i)>=3 then c=0 end
  line(car.x+qx*i-fx*ln,car.y+qy*i-fy*ln,car.x+qx*i+fx*ln,car.y+qy*i+fy*ln,c)
 end
 line(car.x+qx*-2,car.y+qy*-2,car.x+qx*2,car.y+qy*2,7)
 pset(car.x+fx*4+qx*2,car.y+fy*4+qy*2,10)
 pset(car.x+fx*4-qx*2,car.y+fy*4-qy*2,10)
end
function ctext(s,y,c)
 print(s,(128-#s*4)/2,y,c)
end
function hud()
 rectfill(0,0,127,12,0)
 print("LAP "..min(lap+1,3).."/3",3,4,7)
 local s=tstr(race_t)
 print(s,125-#s*4,4,10)
end
function draw_title()
 rectfill(14,40,113,98,0)
 rect(13,39,114,99,7)
 ctext("pico mini gp",48,10)
 ctext("arrows steer",60,6)
 ctext("o gas  x brake",68,6)
 ctext("3 laps to win",78,7)
 ctext("press o",88,11)
end
function draw_win()
 rectfill(16,40,111,94,0)
 rect(15,39,112,95,7)
 ctext("finish!",48,10)
 ctext("time "..tstr(race_t),60,7)
 ctext("best "..tstr(best),70,6)
 ctext("o again  x title",82,7)
end
function _draw()
 cls(3)
 draw_world()
 draw_marks()
 draw_gates()
 draw_car()
 if state=="title" then
  draw_title()
 else
  hud()
  if state=="count" then
   rectfill(46,56,81,74,0)
   rect(46,56,81,74,10)
   print(flr(count/30)+1,62,62,10)
  elseif state=="race" and bt>0 and banner!="" then
   rectfill(46,56,81,74,0)
   rect(46,56,81,74,7)
   ctext(banner,62,10)
  elseif state=="win" then
   draw_win()
  end
 end
 if flash>0 then rect(4,16,123,123,8) end
end
title: 迷你赛车 3圈

design.core_action: 方向键左右转向（转向率随速度变化并带最小原地转向），O 持续油门，X 刹车并可在停车后倒车；速度有惯性、侧向速度按抓地力衰减产生打滑。
design.goal: 在短闭合赛道上按顺序通过 3 个检查点，跑满 3 圈后正向冲过终点线完赛，记录并显示用时。
design.risk: 速度越高转弯半径越大，弯道和窄道需要收油或刹车；撞墙损失速度并轻微反弹，撞得越正损失越大。逆行或乱序通过检查点不计圈，倒着过终点不算圈。
design.controls: 方向键 左/右 = 转向；O = 油门 / 标题开始 / 完赛后重赛；X = 刹车与倒车 / 完赛后回标题。上下键不参与。
design.scenes: title（展示赛道与控制说明，BGM gentle_loop）→ count（3 秒倒计时，车锁定输入）→ race（计时与圈数）→ win（用时与本次最佳，O 重赛 / X 回标题）。
design.audiovisual: BGM：标题 music(6,200,3)，比赛 music(0,200,7)（三声道，声道3留给音效）；撞击 sfx(2,3) 带12帧冷却与红色路缘闪烁，检查点 sfx(5,3)，完成一圈 sfx(0,3)+LAP 提示，GO sfx(1,3)，完赛先 music(-1,200) 再 sfx(3,3)。视觉：深灰路面+红白路缘、格纹终点线、下一个检查点为黄色、旋转绘制的红色车体+白风挡+黄色车灯、打滑留刹车痕。
preserve: 未修改任何内置精灵与音频资源，仅调用现有 SFX 0/1/2/3/5 与 music pattern 0/6
HUD 只占顶部 13 像素，赛道 4..123 / 16..123 与操控逻辑不受改造影响
unresolved: 最大速度(maxf=2)、转向率(turn=0.13)、抓地力(grip=0.82) 的实际手感需 SR 试玩确认
香蕉弯（底部 55..72 凸起）与 3 圈节奏是否合适需试玩
